text:
alex: If you could invite any mythical creature to our next all-hands as a guest, which would you pick and what role would it play?

mira: Phoenix — morale officer. Pops in, revives energy, dramatic entrance. :sparkles::fire:

devon: Kraken as our network admin. Any noisy outage? Kraken casually submerges the problem. :sok: 

liam: Unicorn — HR director. Enforces kindness policy and hands out glittery PTO vouchers. :unicorn_face: :sparkles:

sasha: Time dragon that pauses meetings for 10 mins so async folks catch up. Also eats bad slide decks. :dragon:

mira: also, if it's a phoenix maybe it brings really strong coffee? 

devon: ops-bot: poll created — dragon 2, unicorn 1, phoenix 1, kraken 1 (react to vote)

liam: I actually want a library sprite who whispers TL;DRs into your ear during long docs. Quiet but judgmental. :books: :face_with_monocle:

alex: love the sprite idea. can we have a tiny sprite that also files PRs for formatting? :pray:

sasha: vote for the sprite + unicorn combo. morale + TL;DR is peak productivity. :thumbsup:

devon: weird hill: a mimic disguised as the snack cupboard, very untrustworthy.

alex: ok new rule: if a mythical guest shows up, they must attend the post-all-hands pizza party. no exceptions. :pizza:

ops-bot: Reminder: virtual attendees, please bring mythical creature backgrounds for the call. :camera_with_flash:
